newsitem.title: GERMANY: Walter plans to cut dividend for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Walter plans to cut dividend for 1997.

text.p: German construction group Walter Bau-AG said on Friday it planned to cut its dividend payout for 1997 to eight percent on preference shares and six percent on ordinary shares.

Calculated in marks, Walter Bau plans to pay a dividend of four marks on preference shares, down from eight marks for 1996. On ordinary shares, Walter Bau plans a dividend of three marks, down from seven.
Walter Bau had said in February it was mulling a dividend cut for the second year in a row as earnings were heavily affected by costs linked to the shedding of 1,500 jobs.
The Walter Bau group comprises the building companies Dyckerhoff & Widmann AG, Heilit + Woerner Bau AG and Ed. Zueblin AG.
